answers.core: This is a common GUI use case applicable to developer projects and possible editor enhancements.
answers.workaround: While this can be simulated by scripting using the `item_rect_changed` signal on the child `Control`, it is impossible to avoid nasty jittering of the child during resize, especially if the child `Control`changes size in the axis of the scroll after being added to the scene tree.

title: [ScrollContainer] Add option to hold child at maximum scroll value when resized
